Start by reducing pressure around the crowd. Beacon cannot verify who caused this or whether a rumor is true. Do not point to a family or start punishment. Move supplies behind two visible helpers, keep one open line, and ask the shelter lead to check facts quietly. Protect children and elders from the argument. If threats begin, step back and call local help.
